reasoning_chain: Multiple callers (checkoutservice, frontend, recommendationservice) show slow edges converging on productcatalogservice.
productcatalogservice's own p95 latency is low (0.48ms), indicating it is not slow processing requests but likely CPU-throttled or resource starved.
CPU usage of productcatalogservice is 0.005 cores of 0.010 cores limit, which is 48% of its CPU limit, indicating a very low CPU limit causing resource exhaustion.
Frontend and checkoutservice show high p95 latencies (454.9ms and 412.5ms respectively) consistent with queuing delays waiting on productcatalogservice.
No errors are observed, so the fault is latency due to resource exhaustion, not crash or dependency failure.
productcatalogservice pod was recently recreated with a CPU limit reduced from 200m to 10m, likely causing the resource exhaustion.
